import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 20) := by
  constructor
  · -- Part 1: IsLeast for a²b⁵ divisible by 2000
    refine' ⟨_, _⟩

      use 2, 5
      simp [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
      norm_num
    · -- Show 10 is minimal
      intro n hn hlt
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have h₁ : 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := hdiv
      have h₂ : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
      have h₃ : a * b ≥ 10 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₄ : a * b ≤ 9 := by linarith
        have h₅ : a ≤ 9 := by nlinarith
        have h₆ : b ≤ 9 := by nlinarith
        interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> norm_num at h₁ ⊢ <;> omega
      linarith
  · -- Part 2: IsLeast for a³b⁴ divisible by 2000
    refine' ⟨_, _⟩
    · -- Show 20 is in the set
      use 4, 5
      simp [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
      norm_num
    · -- Show 20 is minimal
      intro n hn hlt
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have h₁ : 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 := hdiv
      have h₂ : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
      have h₃ : a * b ≥ 20 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₄ : a * b ≤ 19 := by linarith
        have h₅ : a ≤ 19 := by nlinarith
        have h₆ : b ≤ 19 := by nlinarith
        interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> norm_num at h₁ ⊢ <;> omega
      linarith

      -- Analyze prime factorization constraints
